newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 13 issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 13 issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp on Monday said that it qualified 13 municipal bond issues, which will be sold competitively, for insurance.
--Industry Urban Developement Agency, Calif., $143 million Refunding bonds.
--New Haven Unified School District, Calif., $14 million General Obligations.
--Florida State, Fla., University Board of Regents $10.230 million
--Seward County Unified School District, Kan., $6.155 million GOs.
--Elk River Independent School District #728, Minn., $26.950 million GOs.
--Eveleth-Gilbert Independent School District, Minn., $3.6 million GOs.
--Woodcliff Lake Board of Education, N.J., $4.358 million GOs.
